myDayNoteId.label: My Day Note
myDayNoteId.description: The note that collects today's tasks. Required: the panel only appears while this note is active, so it stays hidden until you set it. Adding a suggestion appends it here, and tasks already linked here stop being suggested.

addTasksWhenDue.label: Add Tasks When Due
addTasksWhenDue.description: File tasks into the My Day note as their start time arrives.

sendDueNotifications.label: Send Due Notifications
sendDueNotifications.description: Send a desktop notification as each task's start time arrives.

addToTop.label: Add Tasks To Top
addToTop.description: Insert newly added tasks at the top of the My Day note instead of appending them to the bottom. Applies both to the + button and to tasks filed automatically when due.

taskSearch.label: Task Search
taskSearch.description: The Trilium search that decides which notes can be suggested. The default matches any note with a start or due datetime, excluding subtasks. Notes are then bucketed into Earlier, Today and Next 7 Days by their start datetime, falling back to due.

startLabel.label: Start Datetime Label
startLabel.description: The note label holding a task's start datetime, without the leading #.

dueLabel.label: Due Datetime Label
dueLabel.description: The note label holding a task's due datetime, without the leading #. Used when no start datetime is set.

taskLabel.label: Task Label
taskLabel.description: The note label marking a note as a task, without the leading #. Any note carrying it gets an Add to My Day / Remove from My Day button in the right pane.
